description: Release-acceptance evidence contract for the capacitor-mobile-app feature. A candidate's evidence directory is keyed by an immutable build ID and holds a release-manifest.json plus a criteria.json (the deterministic results for criteria 12.1-12.16). scripts/native/release-gate.mjs validates the manifest and applies all-or-nothing, fully-diagnostic acceptance. No secrets are ever tracked here.

fields.buildId: immutable release build identifier; must match the evidence directory name
fields.capacitorVersion: exact semver pin (no range operator), e.g. 7.4.4

compatibility.checkedAt: ISO date the compatibility window was verified
compatibility.qualifyingUpstreamActivity: link to qualifying upstream commit/release activity

endpointHosts.api: bare production API host (no scheme, path, credentials, query, or fragment)

fields.testCommands: array of the exact commands run for this candidate
fields.devices: array of { platform, model, os } target devices
fields.automationIdentity: identity of the automation that produced the evidence (no secret)
fields.artifacts: array of { name, url, sha256 } release artifacts with 64-hex checksums (no secrets)

criteria.description: Deterministic per-criterion results. Every criterion 12.1-12.16 must be present and status:pass for acceptance. Acceptance is all-or-nothing; a rejection enumerates every failed and every missing criterion ID.

entry.evidenceRef: path to the backing evidence file
